free_tier_limits: Open-source self-hosting has no project-imposed usage quota. The official free live demo is limited to 2 requests/second per IP and a 5 MB request body.
rate_limits: Self-hosted deployments have no project-wide request rate limit; operators control deployment limits. The official hosted demo allows 2 requests/second per IP and a 5 MB request body.
resolution_notes: free_tier_limits: Corrected; the current installation guide documents an official hosted live demo and its 2 requests/second/IP and 5 MB body limits: https://gotenberg.dev/docs/getting-started/installation. rate_limits: Corrected; those limits apply to the official demo, while self-hosted API body, timeout, concurrency, and queue controls are deployment-configurable: https://gotenberg.dev/docs/getting-started/installation and https://gotenberg.dev/docs/configuration.
